_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Files a Dotsy bug ticket with what the agent saw. Recent platform errors on the account are attached automatically.

description: Report a Dotsy bug. Recent Dotsy errors on this account are attached automatically. Returns a ticket id; tell the user.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

kind.description: bug (default). question is not available yet.

reportedBy.description: user = the human asked you to report it.

site.description: Site it happened on. Omit for an account-level issue. Stored as about.site; the ticket is filed in Dotsy's inbox.

name: report_bug
